'''''Advances in Computational Mathematics''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published bimonthly by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. Established in 1993 by founding [[editor-in-chief|editors-in-chief]] [[Charles Anthony Micchelli]] and John C. Mason,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Mason |first1=John C. |last2=Micchelli |first2=Charles A. |title=Editorial |journal=Advances in Computational Mathematics |date=1993 |volume=1 |page=1 |doi=10.1007/BF02070817}}</ref> it covers developments in [[computational mathematics]], with a focus on [[approximation theory]], [[computational geometry]], [[numerical analysis]] and [[data analysis]].<ref name="aims-scope">{{cite web |title= Advances in Computational Mathematics: Aims and Scope |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10444/aims-and-scope |website=springer.com |access-date=August 23, 2026}}</ref> Its current editor-in-chief is Alexander Barnett ([[Flatiron Institute]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title= Advances in Computational Mathematics: Editorial Board |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10444/editorial-board |website=springer.com |access-date=August 23, 2026}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[MathSciNet]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[ProQuest|ProQuest databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=August 23, 2026}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title=Advances in Computational Mathematics |issn= 1019-7168 |access-date=August 23, 2026}}</ref>
*[[zbMATH Open|zbMATH]]<ref name=MIAR/>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2025 [[impact factor]] of 2.6.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2026 |chapter= Advances in Computational Mathematics |title=2025 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
